paite: Huchi a Ezra kap a Pathian inn mai a lei kidenna a nei in, athum a, thupha atawi lai in, Israel a kipan pasal leh numei leh naupang tampi kikhawmte akiang ah hong kikaikhawm ua: mite lah anak kah mahmah ngal ua.
heading: Kitenpolhna Sukbeidan Ding Gelna

paite: Elam tapate lak a khat, Jehiel tapa Shekaniah in adawng a Ezra kiang ah, "I Pathian tung ah i talekta ua, gammi numei namdangte i kitenpihta uh: Himahleh hiai thil thu ah Israel a ding in lametna a-om lai hi.

Huaiziak in tu in zite tengteng leh amau a kipan a huchibang a piangte, ka toupa thuhilh dungzui in leh i Pathian uh thupiak a lau a lingte thuhilh dungzui in, koihmang ding in i Pathian toh thu i khung ding uh; huan dan dungzui a hih hi hen.
Thou in, athu lah nang a ahi ngal a, kou leng na kiang ah ka om ding uh; hangsantak in om inla, hih in,” achi hi.
Huchi in Ezra athou a, hiai thu dungzui a ahih ding un, siampute leh Levi mite lak a amakai lianpente leh Israel tengteng akichiamsak hi. Huchi in akichiamta uhi.
Pathian inn mai a kipan Ezra athoukhia a, Eliashib tapa Jehohanan dantan sung ah alut a: huai lai a ahong pai lai in, tanghou ane kei a, tui lah adawn kei hi; saltanna a tatlekna ziak in asuun hi.
Judah leh Jerusalem teng a saltanna tate tengteng kiang ah Jerusalem a kikaikhawm vek ding in thu apuangkhia ua;
kuapeuh ni thum sung a hong pai lou, vaihawmte leh upate thu bang zel in, avan tengteng laksak ahi ding a, amah mah saltanna omkhawmte a kipan a tuamkoih ahi ding hi.

Huchih lai in Judah leh Benjamin mi tengteng Jerusalem ah ni thum sung in akikaikhawm ua; hiai akha kuana, akha ni sawmnih ni ahi. Huchi in mi tengteng Pathian inn kongtual a mun awng ah atu ua, hiai thu leh vuahpi ziak in aling uhi.
Huchi in siampu Ezra adingh a, akiang uah, "Na talek ua, Israel mohna khangsak ding in, numei nam dangte na kitenpih uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in na pipute uh Pathian, TOUPA kiang ah thupha tawi unla, akipah lam hih un; gam a mite a kipan, numei namdangte a kipan kituamseh un," achi hi.
Huchi in kikhawmte tengteng in adawng ua, aw ngaihtak in, "Ka tungtang uh na gen bang in, huchibang in ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
Himahleh mite tampi ahi ua, vuah tampi zuk lai ahi a, huchi in inkuan ah ka dingh thei kei ua, hiai lah ni khat hiam nasep ahi kei; hiai thu ah lah nakpitak in i talekta ngal ua.

Tu in omkhawmte a ding in i vaihawmte ding seh in om henla, i Pathian uh thangpaihna ei a kipan a akihei a, hiai thu hihbei ahih masiah, numei lamdangte kitenpihte i khopite a omte hun sehsate ah, khopi chiteng a upate amau toh, huai lai a vaihawmte toh, hong pai uhen.
Asahel tapa Jonathan leh Tikvah tapa Jahaziah kia in hiai thu asel uh: huan Meshullam leh Levi mi Shabbethai in amaute apanpih uhi.

Huchibang in saltanna a kipan kik nawnte'n ahihta uhi. Siampu Ezra, apipute uh inkote dungzui a, pipute inkuan lak a vaihawm makai kuate hiam toh leh aminte ua amaute tengteng, tuam sehkhiak in a-om ua; huchi in athu entel ding in akha sawmna ani khat ni in atuta uhi.
Huchi in akha khatna ani khat ni in numei namdang kitenpih mite ahih khin uhi.
Huchi in siampute tapate lak ah numei namdang kitenpih muh in a-om a: huaite, Jeshua tapate, Jozadak tapa leh a-unaute, Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib leh Gedaliahte.
heading: Namdangmi Zi A Neite

paite: Huchi in azite uh koihmang ding in pha asa ua; amoh ziak un, amohna a ding in belamhon lak a belamtal alan uhi.
Immer tapate lak ah: Hanani leh Zebadiah.
Harim tapate lak ah: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel leh Uzziah.
Pashur tapate lak ah: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad leh Elasah.
Levi mite lak ah: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah, huai mah Kelita ahi, Pethahiah, Judah leh Eliezer.
Lasa mite lak ah: Eliashib: huan kongkhak ngak mite lak ah; Shallum, Telem leh Uri.
Israel lak ah: Parosh tapate lak ah; Ramiah, Jeziah, Malkijah Mijamin, Eleazar leh Malkijah leh Benaiah.
Elam tapate lak ah: Mattaniah, Zekariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth leh Eliah.
Zattu tapate lak ah: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad leh Aziza.
Bebai tapate lak ah; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
Bani tapate lak ah: Meshullam, Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal leh Ramoth.
Huan Pahath-moab tapate lak ah: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui leh Manasseh.
Harim tapate lak ah: Eliezer, Isshiah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Simeon,
Benjamin, Malluk leh Semariah.
Hashum tapate lak ah: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
Bani tapate lak ah: Maadai, Amram leh Uel;
Benaiah, Bedeiah, Kelluh,
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib;
Mattaniah, Mattenai leh Jaasau;
Bani, Binnui, Shimei;
Shelemiah leh Nathan leh Adaiah,
Maknadebai, Shasai, Sharai;
Azarel leh Shelemiah, Shemariah;
Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.
Nebo tapate lak ah: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel leh Benaiah.
Hiai tengtengte'n namdang zite api ua: huchi in alak ua khenkhatte'n hiai zite a kipan tate anei uhi.
